hook.text: 3 signs you grind your teeth at night

signs.headline:
Sore jaw or headaches
in the morning
signs.caption: Clenching overnight tires your jaw.

signs.headline: Teeth look flat, chipped or shorter
signs.caption: Grinding wears down the biting edges.

signs.headline: New sensitivity to hot or cold
signs.caption: Worn enamel exposes the layer below.

fix.headline: A custom night guard protects your teeth
fix.caption: Made from a mould of your teeth, worn while you sleep.
